roles.name: Cloud Platform Engineer
responsibilities: AWS resources, IAM, networking, observability, deployment posture

tasks.name: Account & Stage Strategy
steps: Create AwsPsmModel with partition, region, and stage strategy.
Define naming and tagging policies.
entryCriteria: PIM transform complete or greenfield PSM
exitCriteria: AWS root and stage strategy configured

tasks.name: Configure Account & Stage Strategy enumerations
steps: Review and set values for: AwsEnvironmentClass, AwsPartition, Decision, Priority, Severity, ConstraintStrength, LifecycleStatus, TraceConfidence, TraceLinkType, FindingType, StructuredFormat, ExpressionLanguage, ExpressionPhase
entryCriteria: PIM transform complete or greenfield PSM

tasks.name: Stack Scaffolding
steps: Create SAM stack with globals.
Define CFN parameters, mappings, conditions, outputs.

tasks.name: Security Baseline
steps: Establish security baseline and IAM roles/policies.
Configure KMS, Secrets Manager, and SSM parameters.

tasks.name: Networking
steps: Configure VPC, subnets, and endpoints when required.
Define security groups and rules.

tasks.name: Identity
steps: Configure Cognito user pools, clients, and groups.
Set up identity pools for federated access.
exitCriteria: Identity resources match PIM auth model

tasks.name: Durable Storage
steps: Provision DynamoDB tables with indexes and streams.
Configure S3 buckets with lifecycle and notifications.
exitCriteria: Durable stores match PIM data model

tasks.name: Messaging
steps: Create SQS queues with redrive policies.
Configure SNS topics and subscriptions.

tasks.name: Event Fabric
steps: Configure EventBridge buses, rules, and targets.
Set up schedules, pipes, and API destinations.

tasks.name: Compute
steps: Deploy Lambda functions with code config and layers.
Configure event source mappings and permissions.

tasks.name: Configure Compute enumerations
steps: Review and set values for: PackageType, LambdaArchitecture, LambdaTracingMode, LambdaRuntimeManagementMode, LambdaSnapStartApplyOn, LambdaInvokeMode, LambdaFunctionUrlAuthType, LambdaRecursiveLoopMode, LambdaEventSourceKind, StartingPosition

tasks.name: API Gateway
steps: Configure HTTP/REST/WebSocket APIs with routes.
Set up integrations, authorizers, and stages.

tasks.name: Configure API Gateway enumerations
steps: Review and set values for: ApiGatewayKind, ApiGatewayEndpointType, ApiGatewayAuthorizationType, ApiGatewayIntegrationType, ApiGatewayHttpMethod

tasks.name: Workflow & Observability
steps: Deploy Step Functions state machines with ASL.
Configure CloudWatch logs, alarms, and dashboards.

tasks.name: Integration Views & Readiness
steps: Create integration relationship views.
Complete trace and readiness closure.
Pass PSM EVL before M2T generation.
exitCriteria: PSM EVL passes; readiness gate approved

tasks.name: Configure Integration Views & Readiness enumerations
steps: Review and set values for: EventBridgeHttpMethod, EventBridgeTargetKind, EventBridgeConnectionAuthorizationType, SqsQueueType, SnsProtocol, SnsFilterPolicyScope, StepFunctionType, AslStateType, DynamoDbBillingMode, DynamoDbAttributeType, DynamoDbKeyType, DynamoDbProjectionType, DynamoDbStreamViewType, DynamoDbTableClass, S3VersioningStatus, S3BlockPublicAccessMode, CognitoMfaConfiguration, IamEffect, ParameterType, SsmParameterTier, ValueSourceKind, ValueType, CloudWatchComparisonOperator, LogGroupClass, SamCapability
